note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the January 1934 cohort); nominations Friday 6 May, poll Monday 16 May 1938 (15 May was a Sunday). The Northern Ireland Individual Traders and Anti-Monopolist Association nominated in eight wards; after six withdrawals on 7 May twelve members were returned unopposed and Dock, Ormeau and Shankill were contested (Belfast News-Letter, 7, 9 and 17 May 1938). State of the Council afterwards: Unionists 46, Nationalists 7, Independent Unionists 3, Socialists 3, Progressive Unionist 1. Returned unopposed.
